purpose: Repository-reviewed evidence specifications for the local Wingman catalog. These named contracts are data; application code proves predicates and enforces safety.

globalPolicy.alerts: Preserve the existing official alert UI, source instructions, spatial and temporal applicability, watch/warning distinction, and update lifecycle. Absence or expiry never proves all-clear.
globalPolicy.activityBinding: Explicit activity preference may choose an advice topic but does not prove an outing today. In preference-only mode the UI must supply a conditional context label such as 'If you are cycling' or a suitably conditional variant. Actual scheduled wording requires a known/proposed activity interval.
globalPolicy.locationBinding: Use the viewed forecast location for general tips and the existing resolved event venue for event tips. Current-area fallback is visibly labeled and refreshed after travel without moving explicit events.

probabilityBands.note: Starting editorial bands only; normalized probability and liquid-rain type are required. Reconcile with the provider. Never treat chance as amount, intensity, or whole-outing probability.

globalPolicy.comparisons: Complete comparable intervals, meaningful improvement, and known-hazard exclusions are required. A comparative score is not an event-wide probability. Name a time window only if coverage supports it.
globalPolicy.freshness: Use documented provider-specific policies. fetchedAt cannot renew stale observation/issue time. Missing and stale are different from zero.
globalPolicy.weatherOnlyCommutes: No current traffic, travel-delay number, route-wide weather, accident, closure, or weather-causation claim from a point forecast.
globalPolicy.catalogDelivery: Bundle locally. No runtime content/API/database dependency.
globalPolicy.variantRule: Every variant must satisfy its family contract and any narrower requirements. If extra evidence is missing, choose a supported variant or revise wording; do not broaden eligibility.

families.title: Likely liquid rain during an outing
families.claimLimit: Use a supported day or outing interval; no inference of all-day rain or rain intensity.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Possible liquid rain during an outing
families.claimLimit: Possible, not certain; never say rain is currently occurring from probability alone.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Currently observed light or moderate rain
families.claimLimit: Now at the displayed place only; current observation must remain fresh.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Higher rain likelihood later today
families.claimLimit: Later means later than now on the location's local date; show the supported interval.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: General outing in a lower-rain window
families.claimLimit: A comparative chance only; display a verified time range beside window-referencing copy. Wording compares hourly probabilities only; never publish a derived whole-outing probability or claim that current rain ended.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Lower forecast rain chances after current rain
families.claimLimit: The ID is historical shorthand. This never proves actual rain ending, reduced intensity, or exact end time. Wording compares hourly probabilities only; never publish a derived whole-outing probability or claim that current rain ended.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Rain likely in the upcoming evening
families.claimLimit: This evening refers to the location's current local date; use a separate qualified form for another date.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Walking in currently observed rain
families.claimLimit: Surface slipperiness is conditional, not observed; this describes a walk now or imminently.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Dog outing with rain in its window
families.claimLimit: Preference-only use requires a conditional activity caption; do not invent a scheduled walk.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Dog outing in warm or hot conditions
families.claimLimit: Cooler hours are a conditional planning suggestion unless a separate verified window is shown; no dog-safe cutoff.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Dog outing in cold conditions
families.claimLimit: Describe comfort and flexibility, not a universally safe duration, temperature, or breed-specific medical instruction.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Dog outing in gusty conditions
families.claimLimit: Sheltered routes are suggestions where available; not confirmed route conditions.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Dog outing in a comparatively lower-rain window
families.claimLimit: A verified selected interval must accompany the copy; cover the intended walk duration. Wording compares hourly probabilities only; never publish a derived whole-outing probability or claim that current rain ended.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Planned dog outing after sunset
families.claimLimit: Requires an actual proposed activity interval after local sunset; a dog preference alone is insufficient.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cycling with likely rain in its window
families.claimLimit: Wet traction is conditional; do not claim a road is measured wet or a ride is safe.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cycling in gusty conditions
families.claimLimit: No headwind/tailwind or route exposure claim without route/direction evidence.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cycling in warm or hot conditions
families.claimLimit: Cooler departure recommendations need a verified comparison if any time is named.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cycling in cold conditions
families.claimLimit: A layering suggestion is not a guarantee of comfort or safety.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Planned cycling after sunset
families.claimLimit: Requires a proposed activity after local sunset; preserve date/time across midnight.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cycling in a comparatively lower-rain window
families.claimLimit: Show the supported range; all activity intervals must be covered. No guaranteed dry ride. Wording compares hourly probabilities only; never publish a derived whole-outing probability or claim that current rain ended.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Weather-based commute rain preparation
families.claimLimit: Weather at the labeled scope during the commute window; no measured traffic, delay, causal attribution, or route-wide weather.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Weather-based commute snow preparation
families.claimLimit: Slipperiness and delays are possibilities; no actual roadway or traffic claim.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Weather-based commute low-visibility preparation
families.claimLimit: No inferred fog from high humidity alone and no known route closure or traffic claim.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Weather-based commute gust preparation
families.claimLimit: Exposure is conditional unless actually known; gusts at one endpoint are not proof across the route.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Weather-based commute freezing-precipitation preparation
families.claimLimit: Needs provider-identified freezing precipitation. Roads may become slippery; actual road ice is not established.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Heat preparation for an outing
families.claimLimit: No medical cutoff or guaranteed cooler time. Check named times using actual hourly evidence.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Layers for a cooler morning and warmer afternoon
families.claimLimit: Both periods must be observed in the forecast at the same place and date; no seasonal assumption.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Layers for a warm day and cooler evening
families.claimLimit: Both relevant periods require forecast coverage; no assumption that every evening cools.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Cold-weather preparation
families.claimLimit: Cold alone is not ice, snow, or slippery-pavement evidence.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Preparation for notable gusts
families.claimLimit: Use a named gust field and configurable comfort band; no damaging-wind claim from an arbitrary cutoff.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Preparation for warm humid conditions
families.claimLimit: Humidity alone does not imply heat. Do not infer pollen, AQI, or a medical heat index.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Daytime elevated-UV preparation
families.claimLimit: A daily peak is day-level only; current/nighttime UV needs matching data and daylight context.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Guidance for an elevated air-quality category
families.claimLimit: Category-specific guidance must be appropriate for the user scope. Current AQI cannot establish a later trend.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Outing preparation with snow expected
families.claimLimit: Potential slower travel/slipperiness remains conditional. No ground accumulation or measured surface claim.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Outing preparation with freezing precipitation expected
families.claimLimit: An air temperature around freezing is insufficient. Preserve official hazard priority.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Outing preparation with fog or low visibility expected
families.claimLimit: No inferred measured visibility from a generic cloudy/humid icon. Walking-specific variants need a walking context.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Rain preparation for an outdoor calendar event
families.claimLimit: Event existence, outdoor setting, location provenance, and interval are known. No automatic venue lookup.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Heat preparation for an outdoor calendar event
families.claimLimit: No assumed shade/water at the venue; suggestions are conditional.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Layers for an outdoor evening event
families.claimLimit: Do not assign an evening time to an all-day event. Sitting-specific wording is conditional.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

families.title: Recoverable absence of a reliable forecast
families.claimLimit: The copy does not perform a refresh. Unsupported capabilities, out-of-horizon events, and denied permissions use their existing specific states.
families.cooldownPolicy: Prefer less-recent eligible wording only within comparable priority; pin active situation and never suppress an important ongoing hazard.

predicateDefinitions.dog_activity_context: Explicit dog-walking preference or known activity. A known/user-selected interval is additionally required for definite variants; otherwise present suggestions conditionally for the displayed period.
predicateDefinitions.cycling_activity_context: Explicit cycling preference or known activity. A known/user-selected interval is additionally required for definite variants; otherwise present suggestions conditionally for the displayed period.
predicateDefinitions.driving_commute_context: Known driving commute interval, or a user-configured driving routine with applicable local weekday and time window. An interest toggle alone is insufficient. Do not infer commute occurrence outside that routine.
predicateDefinitions.walking_activity_context: Known walking activity, user-selected walking context, or a clearly conditional walking suggestion for an explicit walking preference.
predicateDefinitions.known_dog_activity_interval: User-selected/known dog outing or a visibly proposed optional interval. Template dog_after_dark_01 needs a genuinely user-selected/known interval because it says planned.
predicateDefinitions.known_cycling_activity_interval: User-selected/known ride or a visibly proposed optional interval. Template bike_after_dark_01 needs a genuinely user-selected/known interval because it says planned.
predicateDefinitions.known_or_user_selected_activity_window: An actual calendar/routine occurrence or a user-selected intended activity time. A general interest, automatic suggestion, or unconfirmed inferred activity is insufficient.
predicateDefinitions.explicit_outdoor_event: Known event whose outdoor nature is established, not merely a keyword that could also describe an indoor/virtual meeting.
predicateDefinitions.complete_comparison_windows: Enough valid hourly intervals to cover the complete intended outing, including every overlapping interval and comparison period; no gap is treated as benign.
predicateDefinitions.local_sunset_or_night_evidence: Date/location-specific sunset/night evidence for the intended interval. Do not use device timezone or today's sunset for another place/date.
predicateDefinitions.notable_gusts_outlook: An actual supported gust value meeting a documented configurable comfort threshold. Do not derive gusts from sustained wind alone or invent a damaging-wind label.
predicateDefinitions.warm_or_hot_outlook: A supported temperature/apparent-temperature field meeting documented comfort thresholds for the context; no medical or universal dog-safety meaning.
predicateDefinitions.refresh_may_resolve_absence: Ordinary missing/stale/recoverable weather data with an existing user-initiated refresh. Not unsupported AQI/pollen, missing consent, or an event outside forecast horizon.
